version.changelog: 回退v3.22.0: 撤销'分支模式'和'直接跳到执行阶段'改动, 回到v3.21.0状态

llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed Obsidian note organizer, but it can directly modify, rename, delete, and enrich vault notes without consistent user confirmation.

dimensions.detail: Vault-wide reading/searching and note edits are purpose-aligned, but rename/delete/patch actions plus arbitrary image URL checks and web enrichment are high-impact without tight scope or consistent approval gates.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions and local Python helper scripts with no observed remote payload retrieval, dependency installation, tool spoofing, or install-time persistence.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly has direct execution modes for normal kg commands that do not ask before file changes, while also allowing broad activation on messages beginning with kg or paths containing vault.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system-level persistence or credential/session access was found; the skill creates _working checklist files that may persist across interrupted runs and later be deleted as part of the workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and main instructions are coherent for organizing an Obsidian KG-style vault; the bundled scripts are narrower helper tools rather than full implementations of the advertised automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use the explicit kg 检查 flow for a preview, keep backups of the Obsidian vault, restrict the working path to the intended vault, and avoid direct execution or web enrichment unless you are comfortable with the agent changing files and contacting external URLs.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the scripts alone do not perform full vault automation, but the primary artifact is an agent skill whose main workflow instructs the agent to perform those operations with file tools.
[LP3] unexpected: Accepted as a Review concern: the skill calls for broad read, write, move, delete, search, environment-variable, and script authority without an explicit permission boundary.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted: path-based auto-triggering is too broad for a skill that can mutate vault files.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted for direct execution modes: the skill says kg note and kg 完善 flows should immediately execute discovered changes without waiting for user confirmation.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded for generated checklist cleanup: deleting the two task checklist files is disclosed and limited to transient _working files, though actual note deletion remains covered by the broader confirmation concern.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: web enrichment is related to filling missing knowledge, but it introduces untrusted external content into notes and should be opt-in with review before writeback.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: checking embedded image URLs can contact arbitrary note-derived endpoints and is not tightly bounded.
[TT2] expected: Downgraded: OBSIDIAN_VAULT controls where helper checklists are written, which is expected for a vault workflow, but users should ensure it points only to the intended vault.
[SDI-4] expected: Downgraded: the checklist script labels are imprecise, but SKILL.md clearly documents that the check file is a one-line bitmask rather than a full checklist.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-only examples and documentation match the Chinese-language KG note workflow and are not treated as a security concern here.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF run reported no rule results, so it did not add an independent malicious finding.
